tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the seven species groups with the label in the requested language and the species count. Call first to learn the valid `category` values.

tools.name: search_animals
tools.description: Search species by free text in any of eight languages or by scientific name, with optional category, habitat and ISO country filters. Ranked by iNaturalist observations. One page of card-sized records.

tools.name: get_animal
tools.description: Read one species: every common name, scientific name, habitats, country observation counts, the full photo credit and the Wikipedia summary.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List every ISO country code that carries observations with its species count.
